name: Wright State Inclusive Courseware
description: In some classes, the book comes with the class at a price below what it costs in stores.
eligibility: Students in a class that uses it.

steps: Look up your class in WINGS. It shows if the book comes with the class.
Do not buy that book somewhere else first.
Call the campus store with questions, 937-775-5600.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: If aid pays for books, it covers this only if money is left after tuition. You can opt out, but you then buy the book on your own.
